messages:
Nico: Heads-up, noticed invoice-preview reporting a sudden +$120 projected delta for tenant 'atelier' since the route-resolver canary rolled out. Traffic volume steady, but costs jumped.
Anya: I see it too. Console shows spike in 'per-route price' allocation for route alias 'creative-v2' — but that alias shouldn't be billed at that SKU. Might be alias->route_id canonicalization mismatch.
Raj: canary-bot: route-resolver:v2 canary began at 1715023200 -> 5%
canary-bot: canary id=cr-2026-03-22-002, initial 5%
billing-bot: sample billing_event: { tenant: "atelier", tokens: 987, route_alias: "creative-v2", route_id: "r-legacy-17", price_plan: "premium-embed" } -> invoice shows premium pricing applied but tenant is on standard Sku.
Sasha: quick hypothesis: the resolver returns both route_id and route_alias, downstream enrichment picks price_plan by alias first. v2 changed alias precedence ordering.
Nico: can we run a query to find events where route_alias != NULL and price_plan != tenant_plan?
Sasha: running now:
```
SELECT count(*) AS mismatches, tenant, route_alias, price_plan, tenant_plan
FROM billing_events
WHERE route_alias IS NOT NULL
AND price_plan != tenant_plan
AND ts > now() - interval '45 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant, route_alias, price_plan, tenant_plan
ORDER BY mismatches DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Sasha: results: atelier (creative-v2, premium-embed vs standard) -> 3,120 events in last 30m. reseller-acme shows similar pattern but mapped to reseller-account.
Anya: UX/Console ask: add a "Projected Invoice Drift" card that shows before/after totals when a rollout changes route->price mapping. Toggleable per-canary. Helps PMs decide whether to abort ramp.
Raj: short-term mitigation: flip resolver precedence back to prefer explicit route_id price mapping over alias lookup. I can patch a hotfix and push to canary immediately.
Nico: also add an invariant check in resolver: if route_alias maps to a price_plan different from tenant_plan and the delta > $50 in 30m, emit alert and auto-hold canary.
Sasha: create metric metering.quality.route_alias_conflict_rate per-tenant. Alert threshold: >0.2% over 10m -> pager to oncall, >1% -> auto pause canary.
Anya: front-end: I'll add the invoice-drift card and a small banner on the rollout page that previews the projected change. Mockup will include a toggle: "Show projected charges using current canary mapping" and a link "Why charge changed?" to expand details.
billing-bot: quick calc: atelier projected delta = $120.45 over 30m, peak hit 3.1k events mapped to premium.
Raj: PR ready, reverting alias precedence: https://git/repo/pull/1470. Will attach a flag so we can roll forward again once we add the canonicalization tests.
Nico: good. Backfill: write an enrichment backfill that re-evaluates price_plan for events in the last 2 hours with updated precedence; but do it as dry-run first and produce a diff report. If diffs show >1000 events changed -> run in small batches.
Sasha: agree on dry-run. I'll add a dashboard card showing "backfill diff estimates" so ops can approve. Also add a synthetic sampling sink that captures raw pre-enrichment events at 0.5% during rollouts.
Anya: UI tasks: card + banner + toggle + details. Filing ticket #1481 and will link to PR.
Raj: I'll push the hotfix to canary and set canary-bot to auto-pause if metering.quality.route_alias_conflict_rate > 1% for any tenant for 5m.
canary-bot: canary paused for route-resolver:v2 (cr-2026-03-22-002). Hold reason: route_alias conflict metric exceeded threshold.
Nico: Assign owners: hotfix/patch = Raj, backfill/dry-run = Sasha, console UX + query link = Anya, alerts gating = Nico.
Sasha: follow-ups: add unit + integration tests for alias precedence, add a migration that documents canonical route mapping (alias->canonical route_id) and surface in console.
Nico: please include a blameless note in the rollout ticket; key lesson: any resolver change that affects billing mapping must have a pre-flight projection test and a circuit-breaker in rollout config.
Anya: noted, documenting projection card requirements. I'll add a checkbox to rollout checklist: "billing projection and conflict metric present".
Raj: pushing patch to staging now. Will update thread with PR + staging link once validated.
Nico: thanks all. Closing thread; we'll re-open if backfill diffs are surprising.
